grammar.constraint: global finite sets are necessary not sufficient; exact tag/attrs/class/static values/parent-child/text programs instantiate from each source and approved input. No attribute allowed at unrelated node; no style/hidden/on* attrs, no template/noscript/data text mirrors. Source SVG attribute case exact; HTML names ASCII casefold only.
grammar.root: one doctype html then unique html[lang=zh-Hans] with exactly head/body; outside only ASCII layout whitespace; no implicit closing/repair; meta/link/input void; path/circle/rect selfclosing only inside source svg
grammar.program_semantics: lexical tokens concatenate to exact fixed source. Trusted finite expansion of listed if/elif/else/for/empty/block/extends/include/timezone directives only; approved DTO determines guards/cardinality, never observed DOM. Leaves are output locations, not arbitrary text. Blocks override base title/content; article include fixed only. Unknown directive/filter/tag/variable/attribute/node rejects. No generic eval or rendering expected from observed. C021: only fixed source token positions may use nested token for+parentloop.counter0; 30000 steps/3 loop depth/512 array items. No generic dynamic evaluation.
tags_semantics: race_field actual field from DTO with grade/date/time/eligibility special pure contract
race_field as eligibility stores local scalar derived from approved raw eligibility
grammar.nonleaf_text: leaf text/headers/wrappers and leaf table/podium counts/annotation completeness are deferred to phase5; only the explicit injection-plan leaf positions may be scalar text holes. All other literal text exact modulo defined ASCII-layout normalization; every variable/tag scalar tied to program token index and independent trusted DTO evaluation; no wildcard text. Loops materialize exact ordered approved arrays, includes complete; not separate capability success.
grammar.visibility: leaf holes do not allow arbitrary added nodes/visible text; fields must consume actual full text, source wrappers independently checked phase5. Any ancestor hidden attr/style/aria-hidden=true or unapproved class/aria/value blocks leaf; aria-hidden=true exact source SVG ignored as nonleaf but counted; details[history-more] retained collapsed nonleaf, never supplies result. CSS responsive site-nav hidden is source-reviewed nonleaf only. Leaf ancestor CSS selectors must have no display:none/visibility:hidden/opacity:0/offscreen/clip/text collapse/pseudo text; ordinary overflow hidden race-hero is reviewed decoration and does not prove pixels.
grammar.role_parts: hero ribbon/name/crew form exactly one logical role, same parent same opaque row, no intervening foreign visible nodes except source layout whitespace; other hero schedule nodes are separate exact envelope. Podium standalone sibling, not nested role borrowing.
grammar.comments: comments counted resource nodes; only zero-content ASCII-layout comments allowed, no comment supplies visible fields; unknown comments rejected
grammar.budgets: wire bytes full html bytes; decoded bytes full UTF8 text encoding after strict decode before entity; depth counts all element ancestors (html=1); nodes all element/text/comment/doctype events including script/hidden/nonleaf; markers all data-o03-marker attributes; fields all data-o03-field attrs; rows all tr plus each non-tr node carrying data-o03-row (hero parts counted separately). Equality to limit allowed; no truncation.
grammar.publication: source programs are existing template bytes. Injection plan not applied in C020; future resulting templates/source descriptor must undergo R hash review before actual adapter certification.
